notes: Cycle uses A-min path (1-3 crates, no architectural fork).
Cycle crosses two crates: chronos-store (source-of-truth accessor) and chronos-mcp (consumer + wire layer).

Spec correction: the proposal and earlier spec draft named the session-persistence tools with underscores-as-separators (session_save / session_list / session_load); the actual MCP tool names registered in server.rs are save_session, list_sessions, load_session, delete_session, drop_session. Spec REQ-M9-82-03 and the proposal scope/acceptance bullets were amended mid-cycle with a note documenting the correction and extending the contract to all five tools symmetrically.
CHRONOS_MCP_PATH was set explicitly to the rebuilt binary path so the stale-binary symptom flagged in AGENTS.md §1 cannot mask regressions in T4-smoke.

The full workspace T3 command (`cargo test --workspace --lib --tests --exclude chronos-sandbox --exclude chronos-e2e --no-fail-fast`) was attempted but cancelled after 20 minutes (stalled in chronos-native ptrace tests per AGENTS.md §6.5; this is the documented pre-existing flake and not a regression of this cycle).
